[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC bob-cli-qq[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Property Card Cabinets[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Child areas, sub-projects, notebooks, albums, and album records [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]open as collapsible cabinets at the bottom of their note's Property[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]Card. Each cabinet shows exactly the data its H2 section showed. [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]Album Schema and bank Setup move into the same chrome as a restyled[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]Properties cabinet, and `_` becomes a numbered, cancel-safe cabinet[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]pick. The stored catalogs stay bob-owned Markdown, and nothing in [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]bob-cli, the release train, or Bob Mac Capture changes. The work [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]lands dark beside bob-cli-qj, bob-cli-qm, and bob-cli-qp and [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]switches on only after the sibling go-lives it would race.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]9[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]5[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]plan:202611/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]property_card_cabinets.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim] Prompt: [#87AFFF][/dim]prompts/202611/property_card_cabinets.md[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Bead: [#87AFFF][/dim]bob-cli-qq[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Page: [#87AFFF][/dim]https://github.com/bobs-org/bob-cli--beads/blob/main/pages/bob-cli-qq/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]README.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Cabinet gate, model, session state, provider registry, and the[bold black on #FFD75F][/bold #D7AFFF] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]view collector[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]kit[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]kit: add the cabinet-owned `cabinetsPreview` gate. Add the frozen kind [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]table with canonical ranks, roles, and defaults; bottom-up numbering; [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]session state per (path, kind) with rename/delete carry; the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]content-provider registry; the view-scoped cabinet collector; a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]role-aware `_` fold facade; and one toggle router. Also add the go-live [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]dependency edges onto the gating sibling go-lives and COORDINATION [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]notes.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Walker-footer overlay push/pop API[/bold #D7AFFF]                            [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]footer[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]footer: add a LIFO overlay API on the ledger walker-footer status item. [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Live walk painters defer while an overlay is up, and popping repaints [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the current state. A hidden footer unhides for the overlay's lifetime, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and a view-local fallback strip covers a hidden status bar. Both [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]surfaces get aria-live, and the API never writes the vault or spawns [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]bob.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Catalog recognition, ownership claims, render-time hiding, and[bold black on #FFD75F][/bold #D7AFFF] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]the body renderer[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]absorption[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]absorption: spike Vim motion over hidden ranges in real Obsidian first. [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Then build a region.rs-mirroring recognizer and fingerprinted ownership [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]claims, a Live Preview StateField hide (fallback ladder), the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]strict-inside reveal, Reading section tagging, a stand-down helper for [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]inline painters, the navigation reveal hook, and a generic catalog body [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]renderer.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]One cabinet chrome, delegation, the stack, and the CSS region[/bold #D7AFFF] [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]chrome[dim] · [dim][/dim]after kit[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]chrome: build the shared cabinet header and drawer. Delegate fold rows [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF](Schema, Setup, Outline) and the Properties foot to it under the gate, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and assemble one ordered stack per card with Properties last. Mount [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]content providers lazily, add the pick-badge painter, flip album Schema [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]to closed-when-healthy, fix the bank foot keycap, and own the new [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Cabinets CSS region.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]The `_` dispatch and numbered cabinet pick[/bold #D7AFFF]                    [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]keys[dim] · [dim][/dim]after chrome, footer[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]keys: route `_` to the details fold (zero extras), a direct toggle [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF](one), or an armed pick (two or more). The pick uses a Scope plus a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]capture listener, and snapshots semantic kinds. It lights the on-card [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]digits and the footer overlay. `__` toggles 1 and `-` toggles [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Properties; Esc, `q`, and Ctrl+[ cancel. Disarm triggers and palette [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]parity are included.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Areas, Projects, Notebooks, and Albums cabinets on area and [/bold #D7AFFF]  [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]project cards[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]host-cabinets[dim] · [dim][/dim]after chrome, absorption[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]host-cabinets: register providers for the four owner catalogs. Each [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]renders the stored callout through the body renderer and the existing [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]painter, lifts title status into the header, and writes honest [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]summaries. Missing and damaged states get an explicit Sync. Each claims [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]absorption, stands inline painters and anchors down, and registers [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]navigation reveal.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  7 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]The album Records cabinet[/bold #D7AFFF]                                     [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]records-cabinet[dim] · [dim][/dim]after chrome, absorption[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]records-cabinet: register the open-by-default Records provider for album[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]cards. It covers the stored index and tally, group folds, the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]empty-album teaching line, and the subscriptions decoration, with [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]absorption claims and painter stand-down. The phase also retargets the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]albums-catalog group jump into the cabinet and measures a 106-record [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]album.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  8 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Real-Obsidian acceptance and screenshot review with the gate [/bold #D7AFFF] [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]open[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]acceptance[dim] · [dim][/dim]after keys, host-cabinets, records-cabinet[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]acceptance: build a sibling scratch-vault e2e runner. It opens the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]cabinets gate and every sibling species gate, and covers every species [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]in Live Preview and Reading, the full keyboard matrix, fail-open [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]contexts, and the passive spy. It also checks content parity and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]screenshots light/dark, narrow/wide, reduced-motion, and forced-colors [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]before a GO/NO-GO.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  9 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Switch cabinets on, docs, approved memory, and clean deploy[/bold #D7AFFF]   [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]go-live[dim] · [dim][/dim]after acceptance[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]go-live: once the gating sibling go-lives have closed, delete the gate [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and update the docs in both repos. Write the new cabinets reference page[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and the approved memory (glossary:cabinet and the selected card strands [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and record). Then run the family passive proof, `bob plugins sync`, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]a post-switch smoke that includes the prose Outline cabinet.[/#D7D7AF]
